[Skip to main content][1]
1. [Home][2]
[An automation engineer working in a high-tech facility, viewing a digital AI robot assistant
overlay on a screen alongside technical code and 3D CAD models.]

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

## One digital twin, clear operational insight

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]
[A person wearing a headset interacts with a holographic display of 3D models and data

# Leading the world in innovative satellite communications

[View our Product Range][141]

## Products

Beam is at the forefront of innovation for products that utilise the Iridium and Inmarsat networks.

“We simply depend on our Beam equipment to be reliable, robust and economical, it is an imperative
component in the base camp.”

Peter McDowell, Antarctic Logistics and Expeditions LLC

## Safety. Reliability. Trust.

These are the reasons thousands of customers have been putting their remote communications needs in
our hands.

[Iridium Everywhere logo]

Beam is the number one choice of companies worldwide that rely on it to deliver voice, data and
tracking communication over the Iridium Network.

[Compatible products][142]
[Inmarsat Logo White 65x195]

Beam has a full suite of voice and data services for your communications requirements, wherever you
are in the world.

[Compatible products][143]

## Maritime

Essential Voice and Data communications across the world’s oceans

[All maritime products][144]

## In-Building

Reliable, robust and quality solutions in remote settings

[All building products][145]

## Emergency

Providing contact when it’s most needed

[All emergency products][146]

## Transport

Hands-free and reliable communication makes a world of difference

[All transport products][147]

## Push-to-Talk

Simple and secure...taking reliable group communications to the next level

[Learn more][148]

## Short Burst Data

Track, Monitor, Trace & Communicate…one system globally

[Learn more][149]

## World Class Support

Offering 24/7 support globally, we pride ourselves in providing the best customer service.

[Product support][150]

## Industry Solutions

Since 1998, COMPAQ has empowered global energy networks with high-performance cable accessories
designed to meet today’s demands and tomorrow’s challenges, in over 40+ markets worldwide.

[
Know More Know More
][39]
[

01

Underground Power Distribution

With three decades of expertise, COMPAQ provides proven underground cable accessories up to 66kV.
Our cable terminations, cable joints, separable connectors are tested to international standards
ensuring performance, safety, and long term reliability.

][40] [

02

Overhead Power Distribution Solutions

COMPAQ powers overhead networks with durable composite polymer insulators, polymer surge arresters,
and protective boots- designed for easy installation, dependable insulation, and lasting outdoor
reliability.

][41] [

03

Substation / RMU / Switchgear / Transformer Solutions

COMPAQ delivers advanced insulation and connection solutions for substations, RMUs, switchgear, and
transformers- engineered for safety, reliability, and long-term performance.

][42] [

04

Renewable Energy Solutions (Wind & Solar)

Reliable cable accessories for renewable power from offshore wind to desert solar. COMPAQ’s
terminations, joints, and connectors ensure efficiency, safety, and long-term stability in extreme
environments.

][43] [

05

Data Centre & Telecom Distribution Systems

Power reliability for data centres and telecom hubs. COMPAQ’s high-performance connectors,
terminations, and insulation systems ensure safety, uptime, and long-term stability in critical
environments.

][44] [

06

Petrochemical & Oil & Gas Plant Solutions

Rugged cable accessories for petrochemical and oil & gas. COMPAQ’s flame-retardant,
corrosion-resistant solutions deliver safety, reliability, and uninterrupted performance in harsh
environments.

][45] [

07

Defence & Military Power Distribution Systems

Defence-grade cable accessories built for extreme conditions. COMPAQ’s rugged terminations, joints,
and connectors ensure secure, reliable, and long-lasting power in mission-critical operations.

][46] [

08

Cable & Telecom Distribution Systems

Reliable, fire-safe accessories for telecom and broadband. COMPAQ’s connectors, terminations, and
sealing solutions ensure secure, durable performance for modern cable networks.

][47] [

09

Wildlife & Asset Protection Solutions

Specialized wildlife and asset protection for power systems. COMPAQ’s boots, arresters, and
insulation solutions prevent outages, extend asset life, and safeguard both grids and the
environment.

][48]

## Enjoying the summer safely

Learn how to protect your health with ECDC's guide for a safe summer.

[Read the guide][91]
[Image of laboratory worker testing for Ebola]

## Ebola disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda

A large outbreak of Bundibugyo virus disease is taking place in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
(DRC) and Uganda. Although information remains limited, we assess the likelihood of infection for
people living in the EU/EEA to be very low.

[Read the latest updates][92]
[Blood. ©Istock]

## Bacterial STIs reach record highs in Europe

New data show that sexually transmitted infections reached record levels across Europe in 2024,
driven by sharp rises in gonorrhoea and syphilis, and widening gaps in testing and prevention.

[Read the news][93]

## Enjoying the summer safely

Learn how to protect your health with ECDC's guide for a safe summer.

[Read the guide][91]
[Image of laboratory worker testing for Ebola]

## Ebola disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda

A large outbreak of Bundibugyo virus disease is taking place in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
(DRC) and Uganda. Although information remains limited, we assess the likelihood of infection for
people living in the EU/EEA to be very low.

[Read the latest updates][92]
[Blood. ©Istock]

## Bacterial STIs reach record highs in Europe

New data show that sexually transmitted infections reached record levels across Europe in 2024,
driven by sharp rises in gonorrhoea and syphilis, and widening gaps in testing and prevention.

Dear Friends and Colleagues,

It our great pleasure to host the 33rd European Congress on Obesity (ECO 2026) in Istanbul, Türkiye,
from 12–15 May 2026.

We are working with great enthusiasm to develop an innovative and interactive scientific programme
that reflects the dynamic and multidisciplinary nature of obesity research and management. The
programme will address the most pressing and emerging topics in the field, fostering lively
discussion, knowledge exchange, and collaboration among clinicians, researchers, and public health
professionals. Advanced digital solutions will be implemented at ECO2026 to enhance access to
scientific content and to facilitate meaningful networking opportunities.

The congress structure will be designed to maximise engagement between delegates and faculty. The
programme will include plenary lectures, thematic sessions, teaching workshops, and moderated
research communication sessions. As in previous years, topics will be organised into four main
tracks: ‘Basic Science’; ‘Behavioural Science and Public Health’; ‘Childhood and Adolescent
Obesity’; and ‘Obesity Management and Intervention’.

We are honoured to welcome leading experts from across the globe who will share their insights and
latest findings. At the same time, we also greatly appreciate your contributions to the scientific
programme as you join us in shaping the discussions that will define the future of obesity science
and care.

Istanbul, a city where continents meet, offers a unique setting that bridges cultures, history, and
innovation. We are confident that ECO 2026 will not only provide an outstanding scientific
experience but also an unforgettable opportunity to connect with colleagues in one of the world’s
most vibrant and historic cities.

On behalf of the Executive and Organising Committees, we very much look forward to welcoming you to
Istanbul in May 2026 for what promises to be an inspiring and enriching congress.

With kind regards,

** Prof. Dilek Yazıcı

### OUR PRODUCT RANGE - Find the Cables and Accessories you need

Use our product search or click one of the filters below to get started. Our portfolio covers

### AT A GLANCE - Who we are, what we do, and the industries we support

At Eland Cables our people are dedicated to excellence and to delivering a tailored service. Our
industry experts work closely with you, combining cable knowledge with in depth experience in your
industry. We also understand that cables are mission critical to your project. It’s why we built
[The Cable Lab][39]: our specialist centre for Quality and Compliance assurance.

### ELAND CABLES: Powering Industry

Dedicated to excellence and powered by people: our team of industry specialists and cable experts
work alongside a wider team of operatives, drivers, and support staff to deliver a first-class
customer service alongside our high performance cables.

Working across all industries, focused on supporting electrification, digitalisation, automation and
green energy projects, we're the leading European cable supplier and we're trusted to deliver.

[ More about us ][42]

### ELAND CABLES: Expertise and Innovation

The Cable Lab is at the forefront of the fight against sub-standard and non-compliant cables,
performing hundreds of tests every week on cables of all types to verify they meet relevant
electrical characteristics, safety criteria and quality standards. 

Our technical experts provide assurance that your cable will deliver the performance expected, now
and in the future.

[ More on the Lab ][43]

### ELAND CABLES: Delivering on Promises

With our Fleet operating across Europe and our drivers carefully offloading customer orders, we
recognise the importance of the 'last mile' - your cables must arrive where and when they're needed
and in optimum condition. 

With an enviable 99% on-time delivery record, whether its just-in-time, timed, or needing a
specialist unloading vehicle, our logistics team work to support your project timelines.

[ More on the Fleet ][44]

### ELAND CABLES: Committed to People and the Planet

Call it ESG, call it Sustainability... it's always been about looking after our employees, giving
back to the communities we operate in and supporting those less fortunate, and recognising our
responsibility towards the environment. 

Sustainability sits as one of our core values, with commitments in place to reduce our carbon
emissions, deliver nature net-positive actions, and continue to protect the health and wellbeing of
our colleagues.

# Sustainable Solutions for Electricity Distribution

We are an international technology company and a family business, which enables green transition,
reliable and safe supply of electricity by creating sustainable solutions for electricity
distribution.
[The city of Como in Lombardy.]

Customer Cases

### Composite Line Post Insulators Bring a Durable and Modern Power Electricity Distribution Network
### to Eastern Finland

Lappeenrannan Energiaverkot chose Ensto’s new composite line post insulators for its overhead line
renewal project in Savitaipale, South Karelia.

[Marko Siira from Ensto, Leena Pöntynen from Elvera and Jiri Jääskeläinen from Järvi-Suomen

Underground cabling is an efficient way to build a weatherproof network and increase network
reliability, as the electricity network is better protected from challenging weather conditions,
such as storms, lightning, snow loads and small...

Customer Cases

### Swedish E.ON Trusts Cold Shrink Technology

Ten years ago, one of the biggest distribution system owners in Sweden, E.ON, made a decision to
move to cold shrink technology in underground cable installations.
[Read More][174]
[Primary substation for a wind farm in Finland.]

Customer Cases

### The Primary Substation Delivered to Wind Farm with Full Turnkey Service

Ensto Maviko has designed and constructed a full turnkey primary substation solution for a wind farm
in Oulainen, Finland.
[Read More][175]
[Wildfires release CO2 emissions and other greenhouse gases that contribute to climate change.]

## We Adapt

Global warming, extreme weather conditions, growing urbanization, and increased electrification
demand smarter and more resilient electrical infrastructures. Our innovative solutions adapt to
these challenges and combat climate change, providing sustainable, long-term answers.

Global warming, extreme weather conditions, growing urbanization, and increased electrification
demand smarter and more resilient electrical infrastructures. Our innovative solutions adapt to
these challenges and combat climate change, providing sustainable, long-term answers.

## Cable Accessories

ETS Cable Components, established in 1988, is the UK’s leading supplier of accessories for low and
medium-voltage power cables. We have always taken a specialist approach to our range without trying
to dilute our offering and as when the business was formed, our cable accessories essentially
included products for installing, supporting, terminating, identifying and repairing power cables.

Our catalogue which is available either in printed or digital format, contains 9 separate product
sections and we have a further 4000 plus product part numbers to include the products in these
ranges.

products. In addition, we also keep a range of related products such as thread reducers and
adaptors. View our cable glands here.

medium-voltage power cables. We have always taken a specialist approach to our range without trying

included products for installing, supporting, terminating, identifying and repairing power cables.

Our catalogue which is available either in printed or digital format, contains 9 separate product
sections and we have a further 4000 plus product part numbers to include the products in these
ranges.

## Ihr zuverlässiger Partner für Kabel, Kunststoffrohre und Schaumstoffe

In den drei Geschäftsfeldern Eupen Cable, Eupen Pipe und Eupen Foam entwickelt und produziert
Kabelwerk Eupen AG hochwertige Kabel, Kunststoffrohre und Schaumstoffe. Mit jahrzehntelanger
Erfahrung zählt unser Unternehmen in den drei vorgenannten Bereichen zu den führenden Herstellern in
Europa.

** **

[[Video laden]][49]

Eupen Cable stellt seit mehr als 110 Jahren erfolgreich erstklassige Kabel und Leitungen für Energie
und Telekommunikation her und liefert die Produkte in über 70 Länder. Eupen Pipe überzeugt mit einer
breiten Produktpalette temperaturbeständiger PVC- und Polyethylenrohre für Gas-, Wasser-,
Abwasseranwendungen und für den Kabelschutz. Eupen Foam liefert Schaumstoffe als Blockware oder
Zuschnitte nach Kundenwunsch schwerpunktmäßig an die Branchen Bedding und Möbel und auch für die
Bereiche Medizin, Verpackung und Industrie.

Unsere lokalen Tugenden sind unsere globale Stärke. Traditionell mit „Made in EUPEN“ verknüpfte
Werte wie Qualität, Sicherheit, Seriosität, Termintreue und Zuverlässigkeit finden Zuspruch auf der
ganzen Welt. Unsere Fähigkeit, Kundenanforderungen zu entsprechen und Erwartungen kompromisslos zu
erfüllen, macht Kabelwerk Eupen AG zu einem zuverlässigen und langfristigen Partner für zahlreiche
nationale und internationale Unternehmen.

## Aktuelles

### InnoTrans 2026

Vom 22. bis zum 25. September 2026 ist es wieder soweit: die InnoTrans, die internationale Leitmesse
für Verkehrstechnik, öffnet ihre Türen in Berlin und auch wir sind wieder dabei! Besuchen Sie uns in
** Halle 12 ** auf **Stand 150 ** – wir freuen uns auf spannende & konstruktive Gespräche rund um:

**Tunnelfunkkabel, Energiekabel, Eisenbahnsignalkabel, Brandsicherheitskabel**

### Nachruf

In tiefer Trauer nehmen wir Abschied von unserem Präsidenten und Vorsitzenden des Verwaltungsrates**
Herrn Alfred Bourseaux**.

[ Nachruf ][50]

## Projektbesuch Stuttgart 21 – High-Tech-Infrastruktur live erlebt

Letzten Monat hatten wir die Gelegenheit, das beeindruckende Großprojekt Stuttgart 21 vor Ort zu
besuchen. Die neuen Tunnelanlagen sowie der neue Tiefbahnhof bieten nicht nur enorme bauliche
Dimensionen, sondern zeigen auch, wie modernste Kommunikationsinfrastruktur in Zukunft den
Bahnbetrieb unterstützen wird.

Ein zentraler Baustein dabei: die Strahlerkabel des Kabelwerkes Eupen. Die Frequenzband-optimierten
Koaxial-Strahlerkabel sind speziell für Tunnelumgebungen entwickelt und sorgen für eine stabile,
gleichmäßige Funkabdeckung für BOS-, Betriebs- und Mobilfunkdienste.

Die fachgerechte Installation erfolgt durch die EQOS Kommunikation, deren Team mit technischem
Know-how unter den anspruchsvollen Bedingungen im Tunnelbau die Kabelsysteme montiert, misst und in
die Gesamtinfrastruktur integriert.

Fazit: Ein beeindruckender Einblick in ein Schlüsselprojekt der künftigen Mobilität – und ein
Beispiel dafür, wie hochwertige Technik und professionelle Umsetzung Hand in Hand gehen. [weitere
Bilder][51]

[Zuklappen][52]

### ♻️ Nachhaltigkeit beginnt mit Verantwortung 🌍

Europa.

** **

[[Video laden]][49]

Eupen Cable stellt seit mehr als 110 Jahren erfolgreich erstklassige Kabel und Leitungen für Energie
und Telekommunikation her und liefert die Produkte in über 70 Länder. Eupen Pipe überzeugt mit einer
breiten Produktpalette temperaturbeständiger PVC- und Polyethylenrohre für Gas-, Wasser-,
Abwasseranwendungen und für den Kabelschutz. Eupen Foam liefert Schaumstoffe als Blockware oder
Zuschnitte nach Kundenwunsch schwerpunktmäßig an die Branchen Bedding und Möbel und auch für die
Bereiche Medizin, Verpackung und Industrie.

Unsere lokalen Tugenden sind unsere globale Stärke. Traditionell mit „Made in EUPEN“ verknüpfte
Werte wie Qualität, Sicherheit, Seriosität, Termintreue und Zuverlässigkeit finden Zuspruch auf der
ganzen Welt. Unsere Fähigkeit, Kundenanforderungen zu entsprechen und Erwartungen kompromisslos zu
erfüllen, macht Kabelwerk Eupen AG zu einem zuverlässigen und langfristigen Partner für zahlreiche
nationale und internationale Unternehmen.

Vom 22. bis zum 25. September 2026 ist es wieder soweit: die InnoTrans, die internationale Leitmesse
für Verkehrstechnik, öffnet ihre Türen in Berlin und auch wir sind wieder dabei! Besuchen Sie uns in

## Projektbesuch Stuttgart 21 – High-Tech-Infrastruktur live erlebt

Letzten Monat hatten wir die Gelegenheit, das beeindruckende Großprojekt Stuttgart 21 vor Ort zu
besuchen. Die neuen Tunnelanlagen sowie der neue Tiefbahnhof bieten nicht nur enorme bauliche
Dimensionen, sondern zeigen auch, wie modernste Kommunikationsinfrastruktur in Zukunft den
Bahnbetrieb unterstützen wird.

Ein zentraler Baustein dabei: die Strahlerkabel des Kabelwerkes Eupen. Die Frequenzband-optimierten
Koaxial-Strahlerkabel sind speziell für Tunnelumgebungen entwickelt und sorgen für eine stabile,
gleichmäßige Funkabdeckung für BOS-, Betriebs- und Mobilfunkdienste.

Die fachgerechte Installation erfolgt durch die EQOS Kommunikation, deren Team mit technischem
Know-how unter den anspruchsvollen Bedingungen im Tunnelbau die Kabelsysteme montiert, misst und in
die Gesamtinfrastruktur integriert.

Fazit: Ein beeindruckender Einblick in ein Schlüsselprojekt der künftigen Mobilität – und ein
Beispiel dafür, wie hochwertige Technik und professionelle Umsetzung Hand in Hand gehen. [weitere

** Halle 12 ** auf **Stand 150 ** – wir freuen uns auf spannende & konstruktive Gespräche rund um:

**Tunnelfunkkabel, Energiekabel, Eisenbahnsignalkabel, Brandsicherheitskabel**

### Nachruf

In tiefer Trauer nehmen wir Abschied von unserem Präsidenten und Vorsitzenden des Verwaltungsrates**
Herrn Alfred Bourseaux**.

[ Nachruf ][50]

## Projektbesuch Stuttgart 21 – High-Tech-Infrastruktur live erlebt

Letzten Monat hatten wir die Gelegenheit, das beeindruckende Großprojekt Stuttgart 21 vor Ort zu
besuchen. Die neuen Tunnelanlagen sowie der neue Tiefbahnhof bieten nicht nur enorme bauliche
Dimensionen, sondern zeigen auch, wie modernste Kommunikationsinfrastruktur in Zukunft den
Bahnbetrieb unterstützen wird.

Ein zentraler Baustein dabei: die Strahlerkabel des Kabelwerkes Eupen. Die Frequenzband-optimierten
Koaxial-Strahlerkabel sind speziell für Tunnelumgebungen entwickelt und sorgen für eine stabile,
gleichmäßige Funkabdeckung für BOS-, Betriebs- und Mobilfunkdienste.

Die fachgerechte Installation erfolgt durch die EQOS Kommunikation, deren Team mit technischem
Know-how unter den anspruchsvollen Bedingungen im Tunnelbau die Kabelsysteme montiert, misst und in
die Gesamtinfrastruktur integriert.

Fazit: Ein beeindruckender Einblick in ein Schlüsselprojekt der künftigen Mobilität – und ein
Beispiel dafür, wie hochwertige Technik und professionelle Umsetzung Hand in Hand gehen. [weitere
Bilder][51]

[Zuklappen][52]

### ♻️ Nachhaltigkeit beginnt mit Verantwortung 🌍

Mit dem Anschluss an **Interzero^{®}** schaffen wir nicht nur für unsere Partner eine zuverlässige
und nachhaltige Lösung zur Entsorgung von Verpackungsmüll, sondern leisten auch einen aktiven
Beitrag zur Ressourcenschonung.
Gemeinsam tragen wir auf diesem Weg dazu bei, **Treibhausgase zu reduzieren** und die
Kreislaufwirtschaft weiter voranzutreiben.

[**Cable Division Recycling Zertifikat**][53]

[**Pipe Division Recycling Zertifikat**][54]

### Eupen Foam auf der Interzum 2025

Ein großes Dankeschön an diejenigen, die uns auf der Interzum besucht haben. Für alle, die noch
einmal eine Zusammenfassung unserer Neuheiten sehen möchten und für die, die nicht zur Interzum
kommen konnten, zeigen wir hier noch einmal unseren Messefilm.

[ Highlights auf der Interzum 2025 ][55]

**EUCARAY® Radiating Cables in Albula Railway Tunnel Switzerland**

Proud to be a part of history!
The new Albula Railway Tunnel on the UNESCO World Heritage Albula Line of the Rhaetian Railways in
Switzerland officially opened on June 8th, 2024, with Swiss Federal Councilor Röstli and other
dignitaries in attendance.
Kabelwerk Eupen AG is honored to have been a supplier for this remarkable project, providing 2 x 6km
EUCARAY® Radiating Cables. These cables will play a vital role in ensuring the safe and efficient
operation of the tunnel for years to come.
Congratulations to everyone involved in this successful endeavor!

### RF Product Application

**EUCARAY® Radiating Cables prove their value for Automation solutions in underground mining**

Findings in a research project of RWTH Aachen highlight that radiating cables deliver exceptional
network performance in underground tunnels, outperforming traditional MiMo directional antennas…

[ Weiterlesen ][56]

### Der erfolgreiche Wiederaufbau nach der Flutkatastrophe in 2021 lässt uns voller Zuversicht in
### die Zukunft blicken.

[ WEITERLESEN ][57]

Für sein Engagement nach dem Hochwasser, konnte Kabelwerk Eupen AG einen durch die BEMAS (Belgian
Maintenance Association) organisierten Wettbewerb gewinnen und wurde als „Equipe Technique de
l’année 2024“ ausgezeichnet.

Sowohl der Preis der Jury, als auch der Publikumspreis, gingen an Kabelwerk Eupen AG.

Wir danken unseren Mitarbeitern*rinnen für ihren tollen Einsatz und ihre Solidarität!

[ WEITERLESEN ][58]

### Besuch der deutschsprachigen Staatsoberhäupter in Eupen

Wir hatten am 12. September die Ehre, die Staatsoberhäupter der deutschsprachigen Staaten in Eupen
zu empfangen. Auf Einladung unseres Königs Philippe durften wir Bundespräsident Frank-Walter
Steinmeier (Deutschland), Großherzog Henri (Luxemburg), Erbprinz Aloys (Liechtenstein) und Präsident
Alexander Vanderbellen (Österreich) zu dem Thema Kreislaufwirtschaft durch unser Rohrwerk (pipe
division) führen.

Für uns war der Besuch eine große Ehre und eine tolle Bestätigung für unsere Arbeit!

Wir bedanken uns auf diesem Wege bei allen Beteiligten.

# Home

## EURAXESS - researchers in motion

### The leading portal for the research community

Are you a researcher ready to take your career to the next level by moving to another country?
Do you represent a research performing organisation in search of top talent?
Look no further! Join the EURAXESS network to access free personalised information and assistance.

[Female scientist working in a laboratory with protective eyewear, illustrating EURAXESS career
development for researchers in Europe.]

### New on EURAXESS

**As part of the Choose Europe for Science initiative, you can now explore national and regional
funding and support schemes available across 27 EU Member States! **

[Explore now][33]

## SEARCH OUR DATABASE

Search
Receive job alerts and much more…

Log in to your EURAXESS account to manage your alerts for new/expiring offers, save your favourite
jobs, searches, and more.

[Log in ][34][Create a free account ][35]

## EURAXESS IN A NUTSHELL

[Close-up of binoculars emerging through yellow paper, illustrating EURAXESS focus on finding
research opportunities in Europe.]

### [The largest database of job, funding and hosting offers in Europe][36]

With 43 European countries and 9 worldwide hubs, EURAXESS is the largest pan-European initiative to
foster researchers’ mobility and career development. We strengthen scientific collaboration between
Europe and the global community, opening doors to endless possibilities for researchers worldwide.

[Job, Funding and Hosting Opportunities][37]
[Concept image of wooden blocks arranged as rising steps with an arrow, representing EURAXESS
support for researcher growth and career development in Europe.]

### [Expert career guidance][38]

Enhance your career with practical insights, free tools and resources to shape your professional
path. Connect with our knowledgeable staff to help you achieve your goals.

[Find out more][39]
[Hand connecting wooden blocks with human icons linked by white lines on a yellow background,
symbolising the network of EURAXESS Service Centres across Europe supporting researchers and
organisations.]

### [EURAXESS Service Centres][40]

More than 600 Service Centres located in 43 European countries offer free personalised assistance to
researchers and research performing organisations on a variety of relevant topics, from relocation
to career development services.

[Find a EURAXESS Service Centre][41]

## THE BENEFITS OF REGISTERING WITH EURAXESS

[Wooden figure holding a sign with a red question mark on a bright yellow background, symbolising a
researcher seeking guidance and opportunities.]
I am a researcher. What can EURAXESS do for me?

Whether you're seeking advice on career development, looking for tools to enhance your skills, or
need concrete assistance with relocating for your next big opportunity, EURAXESS can help. No matter
what stage of your research path or scientific business you are at, EURAXESS is a comprehensive
career and innovation hub for information and assistance. Find jobs, hosting and funding
opportunities, as well as support and guidance.

[Create your profile][42]
[Icons on wooden blocks symbolising recruitment, innovation, and collaboration, representing how
EURAXESS supports organisations in attracting top research talent.]
I represent an organisation. How can EURAXESS help?

Whether you represent a research institution, university, or business, EURAXESS can enhance your
recruitment process. Easily publish your vacancies for free and reach top-tier candidates in Europe
and beyond. Boost your visibility in the research community and attract the best minds to your
organisation.

Are you looking to expand your career development service portfolio? We can help you do so as well!

[Discover more][43]

## HEAR IT FROM OUR COMMUNITY

[Read more success stories][44]
Mark has submitted his PhD thesis and is waiting for his Viva
[Read the full story][45]
Ruth is halfway through a postdoc position she previously found via EURAXESS Jobs
[Read the full story][46]

# Home

## EURAXESS - researchers in motion

### The leading portal for the research community

Are you a researcher ready to take your career to the next level by moving to another country?
Do you represent a research performing organisation in search of top talent?
Look no further! Join the EURAXESS network to access free personalised information and assistance.

[Female scientist working in a laboratory with protective eyewear, illustrating EURAXESS career
development for researchers in Europe.]

### New on EURAXESS

**As part of the Choose Europe for Science initiative, you can now explore national and regional
funding and support schemes available across 27 EU Member States! **

[Explore now][33]

## SEARCH OUR DATABASE

Search
Receive job alerts and much more…

Log in to your EURAXESS account to manage your alerts for new/expiring offers, save your favourite
jobs, searches, and more.

[Log in ][34][Create a free account ][35]

## EURAXESS IN A NUTSHELL

[Close-up of binoculars emerging through yellow paper, illustrating EURAXESS focus on finding
research opportunities in Europe.]

### [The largest database of job, funding and hosting offers in Europe][36]

With 43 European countries and 9 worldwide hubs, EURAXESS is the largest pan-European initiative to
foster researchers’ mobility and career development. We strengthen scientific collaboration between
Europe and the global community, opening doors to endless possibilities for researchers worldwide.

[Job, Funding and Hosting Opportunities][37]
[Concept image of wooden blocks arranged as rising steps with an arrow, representing EURAXESS
support for researcher growth and career development in Europe.]

### [Expert career guidance][38]

Enhance your career with practical insights, free tools and resources to shape your professional
path. Connect with our knowledgeable staff to help you achieve your goals.

[Find out more][39]
[Hand connecting wooden blocks with human icons linked by white lines on a yellow background,
symbolising the network of EURAXESS Service Centres across Europe supporting researchers and
organisations.]

### [EURAXESS Service Centres][40]

More than 600 Service Centres located in 43 European countries offer free personalised assistance to
researchers and research performing organisations on a variety of relevant topics, from relocation
to career development services.

[Find a EURAXESS Service Centre][41]

## THE BENEFITS OF REGISTERING WITH EURAXESS

[Wooden figure holding a sign with a red question mark on a bright yellow background, symbolising a
researcher seeking guidance and opportunities.]
I am a researcher. What can EURAXESS do for me?

Whether you're seeking advice on career development, looking for tools to enhance your skills, or
need concrete assistance with relocating for your next big opportunity, EURAXESS can help. No matter
what stage of your research path or scientific business you are at, EURAXESS is a comprehensive
career and innovation hub for information and assistance. Find jobs, hosting and funding
opportunities, as well as support and guidance.

[Create your profile][42]
[Icons on wooden blocks symbolising recruitment, innovation, and collaboration, representing how
EURAXESS supports organisations in attracting top research talent.]
I represent an organisation. How can EURAXESS help?

Whether you represent a research institution, university, or business, EURAXESS can enhance your
recruitment process. Easily publish your vacancies for free and reach top-tier candidates in Europe
and beyond. Boost your visibility in the research community and attract the best minds to your
organisation.

Are you looking to expand your career development service portfolio? We can help you do so as well!

# Europa-Park Resort

Experience. Time. Together.
Europa-Park Resort

At Europa-Park, you can experience Europe in a single day, while at Rulantica, you can dive right
in. At the Eatrenalin fine dining experience, you embark on a multimedia culinary journey for all
senses. Spend the night in one of the six themed hotels or Silver Lake City and let us spoil you
with culinary delights in the hotel restaurants, cafés and bars, perfectly rounded off with a
soothing massage in the wellness and spa area.

Let us enchant you and create unforgettable moments at the Europa-Park Resort.

Almost every country or trade block in the world has its own detailing on the international HS-code
list. With our report you strongly reduce the risk on misclassifications, delays and higher custom
duties than expected.

## Export knowledge

Our article database covers over 30 countries and several topics such as custom regulations,
distributor search, taxation issues and commercial advice.

We keep a database with export service providers in various countries. They can help you with market
entry, imports & exports,  company incorporation or other topics.

# **High-voltage cable installation & jointing specialists**

Delivering HV Electrical Engineering Solutions to the UK’s onshore & offshore power networks 

[Electrical substation electrical installation]

## High-voltage specialists

Global Power Services is a high-voltage cable installation and jointing specialist operating in the
power and utilities infrastructure sector. 

With decades of experience across the team we are firmly established as a trusted partner to tier 1
operators servicing the onshore and offshore power distribution networks across the UK and Europe. 

[ About ][43]
[Shot Blasting]

## Skilled project delivery

Global Power Services’ leadership team – supported by our skilled and experienced on-site project
teams - brings extensive expertise and a strong track record.

With teams based across the UK and Europe, our core capabilities include Project Management, Duct &
Cable Installation, Cable Jointing, Project Planning, Testing Fibre Installation, Shot Blasting,
Complex Steelwork Installations and Civil & Foundation Installation.  

[ Services ][44]
[Vanguard 1]

## Proven track record

As a long term preferred framework contractor, we are a key supplier to the build out and upgrade of
the UK power networks - including HV commissioning for renewable energy projects. 

Since 2009 we have delivered a range of HV cable schemes (up to 400kV) for all major network
providers, including National Grid, Western Power Distribution, Northern Power Grid, Scottish &
Southern Energy (SSE) and UK Power Networks.

# **High-voltage cable installation & jointing specialists**

Delivering HV Electrical Engineering Solutions to the UK’s onshore & offshore power networks 

[Electrical substation electrical installation]

## High-voltage specialists

Global Power Services is a high-voltage cable installation and jointing specialist operating in the
power and utilities infrastructure sector. 

With decades of experience across the team we are firmly established as a trusted partner to tier 1
operators servicing the onshore and offshore power distribution networks across the UK and Europe. 

[ About ][43]
[Shot Blasting]

## Skilled project delivery

Global Power Services’ leadership team – supported by our skilled and experienced on-site project
teams - brings extensive expertise and a strong track record.

With teams based across the UK and Europe, our core capabilities include Project Management, Duct &
Cable Installation, Cable Jointing, Project Planning, Testing Fibre Installation, Shot Blasting,
Complex Steelwork Installations and Civil & Foundation Installation.  

[ Services ][44]
[Vanguard 1]

## Proven track record

As a long term preferred framework contractor, we are a key supplier to the build out and upgrade of
the UK power networks - including HV commissioning for renewable energy projects. 

Since 2009 we have delivered a range of HV cable schemes (up to 400kV) for all major network
providers, including National Grid, Western Power Distribution, Northern Power Grid, Scottish &
Southern Energy (SSE) and UK Power Networks.

MADE FOR REAL^{}

# Smart Cable Management

MADE FOR REAL^{}

Smart Cable Management

[Cable ties and fixings]

## Cable ties

Cable ties have to be able to meet the most varied demands these days as they are used in the widest
range of operations – from the simple bundling of cables with cable ties to the absolutely specific
use of cable ties under extreme conditions.

[Heat shrink tubing]

## Heat shrink tubing

You are looking for the heat shrink tubing meeting your application requirements best? The key
factors to which we owe our success are the unique and quite specific properties of our heat shrink
tubing.

[Cable protection conduits]

## Wire conduits

No cable can meet the demands posed today in terms of abrasion resistance, tensile strength and form
consistency or impact resistance without having appropriate cable protection. Cable protection
tubes...

[Cable management products]

## Cable management

Whether for the desk or for industry, screwable or self-adhesive, whether clip, conduit or mounting
base, find the right cable management solution for your application now.

[Electrical installation]

## Electrical installation

Professional and skilful electrical installation requires not only well-trained specialists, but
also a well thought-out range of products. To help electricians and engineers make their work more
safe and efficient...

[Cable labels, wire labels for industrial identification]

## Cable labels for industry

You are looking for cable labels, wire labels or cable tags? HellermannTyton offers a wide range of
identification solutions for industrial use.

[Cable tie guns]

## Cable tie guns

From manual and pneumatic cable tie guns to automatic cable tie guns, Hellermanntyton offers a wide
range of cable tie tensioning tools for a variety of requirements. Always reliable and comfortable
and ideal for long-term use.

[RFID technology]

## RFID tracking

HellermannTyton has for many years manufactured a range of identification products that give both
human readable and barcoded identification. To complete the range of asset management identification
HellermannTyton has introduced a new range of RFID tags and cable accessories. The ties are
especially suited for securing, serialisation, tracking and identification of products in the areas
of resource management, electrical inspection, inventory, distribution and rental services as well
as for easy management of maintenance and repair routines.

### Try out our Chatbot Tyton

Tyton is an AI-powered digital assistant that helps you find information, products, and solutions.
* 24/7 support
* Fast access to all information
* Conversational experience

Sign up by clicking on Try Tyton and find the Tyton in the bottom right corner after being logged
in.

[ Try Tyton ][210]

## The sustainable choice in cable management

90 years leading the way in smart cable management: More than ever, HellermannTyton is committed to
innovation that supports responsible consumption and production in line with global climate targets.

Our greatest contribution to reducing environmental impact lies in the carbon emissions of the raw
materials we use to make our products. That's why Source is focused on sustainable materials and
design.

[Discover our Source product strategy][211]

MADE FOR REAL^{}

# Smart Cable Management

MADE FOR REAL^{}

Smart Cable Management

[Cable ties and fixings]

## Cable ties

Cable ties have to be able to meet the most varied demands these days as they are used in the widest
range of operations – from the simple bundling of cables with cable ties to the absolutely specific
use of cable ties under extreme conditions.

[Heat shrink tubing]

## Heat shrink tubing

You are looking for the heat shrink tubing meeting your application requirements best? The key
factors to which we owe our success are the unique and quite specific properties of our heat shrink
tubing.

[Cable protection conduits]

## Wire conduits

No cable can meet the demands posed today in terms of abrasion resistance, tensile strength and form
consistency or impact resistance without having appropriate cable protection. Cable protection
tubes...

[Cable management products]

## Cable management

Whether for the desk or for industry, screwable or self-adhesive, whether clip, conduit or mounting
base, find the right cable management solution for your application now.

[Electrical installation]

## Electrical installation

Professional and skilful electrical installation requires not only well-trained specialists, but
also a well thought-out range of products. To help electricians and engineers make their work more
safe and efficient...

[Cable labels, wire labels for industrial identification]

## Cable labels for industry

You are looking for cable labels, wire labels or cable tags? HellermannTyton offers a wide range of
identification solutions for industrial use.

[Cable tie guns]

## Cable tie guns

From manual and pneumatic cable tie guns to automatic cable tie guns, Hellermanntyton offers a wide
range of cable tie tensioning tools for a variety of requirements. Always reliable and comfortable
and ideal for long-term use.

[RFID technology]

## RFID tracking

HellermannTyton has for many years manufactured a range of identification products that give both
human readable and barcoded identification. To complete the range of asset management identification
HellermannTyton has introduced a new range of RFID tags and cable accessories. The ties are
especially suited for securing, serialisation, tracking and identification of products in the areas
of resource management, electrical inspection, inventory, distribution and rental services as well
as for easy management of maintenance and repair routines.

### Try out our Chatbot Tyton

Tyton is an AI-powered digital assistant that helps you find information, products, and solutions.
* 24/7 support
* Fast access to all information
* Conversational experience

Sign up by clicking on Try Tyton and find the Tyton in the bottom right corner after being logged
in.

[ Try Tyton ][210]

## The sustainable choice in cable management

90 years leading the way in smart cable management: More than ever, HellermannTyton is committed to
innovation that supports responsible consumption and production in line with global climate targets.

Our greatest contribution to reducing environmental impact lies in the carbon emissions of the raw
materials we use to make our products. That's why Source is focused on sustainable materials and
design.

[Discover our Source product strategy][211]

## जनसुनवाई - समाधान पोर्टल एवं मोबाइल एप्लीकेशन
* [ ** जनसुनवाई - समाधान पोर्टल ][40]
* [ ** एंड्रॉइड एप्लिकेशन ][41]
* ### शिकायत पंजीकरण
  
  जनसुनवाई पोर्टल मोबाइल ओटीपी के माध्यम से आसान पंजीकरण की सुविधा प्रदान करता है और किसी भी समय सरकार के हर
  स्तर पर शिकायत को हल करने की सुविदा प्राप्त करता हैI
* ### शिकायत की स्थिति
  
  पंजीकृत मोबाइल नंबर / ईमेल आईडी के माध्यम से शिकायत को ट्रैक करें।
  [ मोबाइल नंबर से पंजीकृत शिकायतें प्राप्त करें][42]
* ### अनुस्मारक भेजें
  
  निर्धारित समय में शिकायत का समाधान नहीं होने पर शिकायतकर्ता रिमाइंडर भेज सकता है।
* ### आपकी प्रतिक्रिया
  
  जनसुनवाई पोर्टल निस्तारण की गुणवत्ता के बारे में प्रतिक्रिया देने की सुविधा प्रदान करता है, जिसका मूल्यांकन उच्च
  अधिकारियों द्वारा किया जाता है और वे निस्तारित किये गए संदर्भो को पुनः जीवित कर सकते हैं।

[dashboard-demo-icon]
* ### जनसुनवाई -समाधान एंड्रॉइड एप्लिकेशन
  1. मोबाइल गवर्नेंस के दृष्टिगत जनसुनवाई एंड्राइड मोबाइल ऐप का निर्माण किया गया है I
  2. इस मोबाइल ऐप का उपयोग कर नागरिक आसानी से किसी भी समय अपनी शिकायत को दर्ज एवं ट्रैक कर सकते हैं I
  3. विभागीय अधिकारी भी उनको प्रेषित शिकायतों को आसानी से देख सकते है एवं उनके निस्तारण हेतु कार्यवाही कर सकते हैं I

## जनसुनवाई - समाधान पोर्टल एवं मोबाइल एप्लीकेशन
* [ ** जनसुनवाई - समाधान पोर्टल ][40]
* [ ** एंड्रॉइड एप्लिकेशन ][41]
* ### शिकायत पंजीकरण
  
  जनसुनवाई पोर्टल मोबाइल ओटीपी के माध्यम से आसान पंजीकरण की सुविधा प्रदान करता है और किसी भी समय सरकार के हर
  स्तर पर शिकायत को हल करने की सुविदा प्राप्त करता हैI
* ### शिकायत की स्थिति
  
  पंजीकृत मोबाइल नंबर / ईमेल आईडी के माध्यम से शिकायत को ट्रैक करें।
  [ मोबाइल नंबर से पंजीकृत शिकायतें प्राप्त करें][42]
* ### अनुस्मारक भेजें
  
  निर्धारित समय में शिकायत का समाधान नहीं होने पर शिकायतकर्ता रिमाइंडर भेज सकता है।
* ### आपकी प्रतिक्रिया
  
  जनसुनवाई पोर्टल निस्तारण की गुणवत्ता के बारे में प्रतिक्रिया देने की सुविधा प्रदान करता है, जिसका मूल्यांकन उच्च
  अधिकारियों द्वारा किया जाता है और वे निस्तारित किये गए संदर्भो को पुनः जीवित कर सकते हैं।

[dashboard-demo-icon]
* ### जनसुनवाई -समाधान एंड्रॉइड एप्लिकेशन
  1. मोबाइल गवर्नेंस के दृष्टिगत जनसुनवाई एंड्राइड मोबाइल ऐप का निर्माण किया गया है I
  2. इस मोबाइल ऐप का उपयोग कर नागरिक आसानी से किसी भी समय अपनी शिकायत को दर्ज एवं ट्रैक कर सकते हैं I
  3. विभागीय अधिकारी भी उनको प्रेषित शिकायतों को आसानी से देख सकते है एवं उनके निस्तारण हेतु कार्यवाही कर सकते हैं I

93310 09004
* An ISO 9001:2008 certified Company, we manufacture and supply the best range of Power Cable Joint
  and Cable Accessories.
  
  [Get in Touch][10]
* Our wide range of products includes [heat shrinkable jointing kits][11], Heat Shrink Single Core
  Straight Joint, Heat Shrink Straight Joint and Shrink Termination.
  
  [Get in Touch][12]
* High voltage cable joints manufacturer, Power Cable Joints Manufacturer, Power Cable Joints and
  Cable Accessories.
  
  [Get in Touch][13]

#### Certified Company

High voltage cable joints manufacturer, **Jointmask** is a certified Company, specialising in
Development, Manufacturing & Marketing of [heat shrinkable jointing kits][14] upto 66 kV.

#### Why Us

Our products find application in power distribution, electrical Insulation, industries &
applications. We have never received any major query or feedback regarding product quality that is
itself a great achievement.

#### Vision

Our company is committed to provide world class products, not only meeting the required standards
and values but exceeding them comfortably. Also, our products are manufactured by using quality
assured materials.

### Product Highlights

COLD SHRINK STRAIGHT JOINTS:
CSS-1133 Series.
The JOINTMASK Cold Shrink terminations provide stress control by utilizing a flexible tube with a
high permittivity dielectric constant.


Tinned / Bare Copper Mesh Tape
We offer wide range of Wire Mesh, jointless, continuous and with uniform borders in various sized,
thickness and width as per customer requirements.


HEAT SHRINK CABLE END CAPS JEC - SERIES :
Heat Shrink Cable End Caps are used to seal the ends of all types of Cables & protect from ingress
of water/moisture. The caps are manufactured from high quality cross linked polyolefin material.


HEAT SHRINK HT BRAKOUT HVB-1133 SERIES :
Heat Shrink Anti Tracking Cable Breakout provide permanent environmental seal to the crutch of 3
core XLPE & PILC cable rating upto 36KV.


HEAT SHRINK RAIN SHED/SKIRT JRS- 1133 SERIES :
Heat Shrink Creepage Extension Skirts are used to increase the surface creepage distance of the
cores of the cable termination without increasing the tail length.


BLACK SEALING MASTIC TAPE :
Preventing leaks of resin ,Particularly suitable for hot climate ,Waterproofing of LV & MV joints.
Reconstruction of LV insulation.


YELLOW MASTIC TAPE :
Preventing leaks of resin, ,Waterproofing of LV & MV joints. Filling voids in joints & terminations.
For stress relief in MV joints & termination.


PUSH ON END TERMINATION INDOOR / OUTDOOR MEPI/MEPO – 1133 SERIES :
JOINTMASK PUSH ON system comprises of precisely engineered and molded EPDM (Ethylene Propylene Diene
Monomer) Rubber Components.


Tinned / Bare Copper Braids
Single & multiple flat braids can be used as continuous current carrying conductors. Flexible
connectors / shunts / links / assemblies enable transfer of high current by using component with
smaller dimension.

**Jointmask** is committed to supply World Class products, not only meeting the required standards &
values but exceeding them comfortably. All our products are in conformance with various

also by Swiss privacy laws.

everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason

ensured.

protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

][180]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries
* [ [agriculture]Agriculture ][168]
* [ [automotice]Automotive ][169]
* [ [Building]Building & Construction ][170]
* [ [Consumer]Consumer ][171]
* [ [Electrical]Electrical & Electronics ][172]
* [ [Healthcare]Hygiene & Healthcare ][173]
* [ [Industrial]Industrial ][174]
* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

We are a top global travel distribution platform, simplifying business for suppliers like hotels,
airlines, and car rentals, and buyers such as travel agencies and online travel companies. Publicly
listed on the NSE and BSE, we connect over 159,000 buyers with 1 million+ hotels in 100+ countries,
ensuring seamless transactions.

## Simplifying Travel. Enabling Growth.

We are always looking at adding Travel Agents and Hotel partners on our platform. Register with us
and grow your business on the largest travel distribution platform in the world!

[ Hotel Partner Registration][14] [ Travel Agent Registration][15]

## All the products you want to grow your business

No more reaching out to all those suppliers for that destination or product. One platform for all
your customer’s need.

### Hotels

1M+ unique hotels, apartments and vacation homes globally. Allows Travel Agents to book
accommodations worldwide.

[Know more][16]

### Air

Offers the lowest airfares across the globe with local payment options. We also provide real-time
bookings of low-cost and full-service carriers worldwide.

[Know more][17]

### Academy

An exclusive online-learning platform for Travel Agents and Travel Trade Partners. It is an
empowering tool for TBO partners and is hence available to them free of charge.

[Know more][18]

### Insurance

Buy Travel Insurance online provides financial safety so that you can enjoy hassle-free travel.

[Know more][19]

### Packages

An increasing demand from travellers enables Travel Agents to customize dynamic holiday packages.

[Know more][20]

### Car

We work with all major rental companies globally and provide instant availability at the best prices
with an option of Book Now - Pay Later.

[Know more][21]

### Zamzam & Kizan

Zamzam.com is approved OTA [Online Travel Agency] by the Ministry of Hajj & Umrah (MoHU), Saudi
Arabia.

[Know more][22]

### Cruise

Tbo Cruise has curated a selection of cruise vacations from the world’s best cruise lines. With a
portfolio spanning contemporary to ultra luxury cruise lines, we offer your guests the opportunity
of becoming lifelong cruisers.

[Know more][23]

### Transfers

Book your private transfer from the airport to the hotel and vice versa worldwide with a wide
variety of options available at the best rates, with an easy booking procedure and hand-picked
suppliers.

[Know more][24]

### Sightseeing

Choose from thousands of tour options and recommendations before and during your trip to best
experience what the destination has to offer.

[Know more][25]

### RailEurope

European Train Tickets on TBO Portal – Search & Book. Travel across Europe and discover over 35
countries by train with TBO. TBO Portal- the easiest way to buy European train tickets & passes
online.

### Why Telegram?

### Simple

**Telegram** is so simple you already know how to use it.

### Private

**Telegram** messages are heavily encrypted and can self-destruct.

### Synced

**Telegram** lets you access your chats from multiple devices.

### Fast

**Telegram** delivers messages faster than any other application.

### Powerful

**Telegram** has no limits on the size of your media and chats.

### Open

**Telegram** has an open [API][40] and source code free for everyone.

### Secure

**Telegram** keeps your messages safe from hacker attacks.

### Social

**Telegram** groups can hold up to 200,000 members.

### Expressive

**Telegram** lets you completely customize your messenger.

##### Telegram

Telegram is a cloud-based mobile and desktop messaging app with a focus on security and speed.

Who are we?
Born in 1997, Trainline is a tech company with the mission to make booking of train and bus tickets
easier, reach new destinations and promote a more sustainable travel sector.

We offer affordable solutions and travel information in real time, displaying routes, prices and
timetables of more than 270 train and bus companies in 45 countries.
When is the best time to book?
Three months in advance! It’s when most carriers release their tickets (apart from Eurostar – look
for Eurostar tickets six months in advance).

Want to get the best price for your journey? Book early. Prices normally go up closer to the
departure date.

Plus, you might not get seats together if you book late (which might be a bonus for the introverts
out there).
Can I cancel my booking?
It depends on the company the booking was made with and on the type of ticket purchased. If sale
conditions allow it, you can easily cancel your booking online.
Can I request a refund for my ticket?
You can request a refund after canceling your booking, if allowed by the ticket terms and
conditions. You can also receive a refund if your train is canceled, and in some cases of delays, by
the train company.

# Power Cable Accessories Manufacturer

Smart Woer, Connect the World
[Shenzhen Woer Electric Technology Co., Ltd. (Woer Electric)]

# Heat Shrink, Cold Shrink and Pre-Moulded Cable Accessories

[More Information][10]
[Shenzhen Woer Electric Technology Co., Ltd. (Woer Electric)]

# 20 Years of Experience in Cable Accessories Manufacturing

With experience based on a multitude of projects spanning two decades, we are highly specialized in
manufacturing custom power cable accessories.
[Shenzhen Woer Electric Technology Co., Ltd. (Woer Electric)]
[Shenzhen Woer Electric Technology Co., Ltd. (Woer Electric)]
Our Products
* 1. [Heat Shrink Kits][11]
  2. [[Heat Shrink Kits]][12] This cable joint is applicable to cables with different cross sections
     and different cores, including single-core cables, two-core cables, three-core cables,
     four-core cables and five-core cables.
* 1. [Heat Shrink Tubing][13]
  2. [[Heat Shrink Tubing]][14]This heat shrinkable tube is applicable to cables up to 42kV. To be
     specific, it protects cables inside and avoids accidental flashover. The operating temperature
     ranges from 90℃ to 130℃.
* 1. [Heat Shrink Moulded Shapes][15]
  2. [[Heat Shrink Moulded Shapes]][16]This heat shrink anti-tracking rain shed is used for
     extending the creepage path for cable terminations. It is made of quality polyolefin that
     ensures excellent insulation performance.
* 1. [Cold Shrink Tubing][17]
  2. [[Cold Shrink Tubing]][18]This EPDM cold shrink tube is aimed to seal and protect against
     chemical corrosion communication cables, coaxial cables and LV&MV cables. It is easy to install
     and the shrinkage requires no flame nor heating.
* 1. [Cold Shrink Moulded Shapes][19]
  2. [[Cold Shrink Moulded Shapes]][20]This cold shrink silicone rubber breakout creates an
     environmental enclosure for cable phase and overall cable jacket. It is expanded and mounted on
     removable inner supporting plastic cores in factories.
* 1. [Separable Connector (European Standard)][21]
  2. [[Separable Connector (European Standard)]][22]This connector set includes a separable
     connector that links cables to interface C bushings, like transformers and switchgears, and a
     rear connector to work as a connector extension.
* 1. [Separable Connector (American Standard)][23]
  2. [[Separable Connector (American Standard)]][24]Compatible jointing devices include single
     feed-thru bushing, dual feed-thru bushing, 200A interface for bus bar, 200A interface for etc.
* 1. [Inner Cone Plug-In Termination][25]
  2. [[Inner Cone Plug-In Termination]][26]The product dimensions fulfill EN-50181 design standard
     and the product performance is in compliance with GB/T28427-2012 standard. The fitting adopts
     dual contact band design to allow a larger discharge capacity.
[Company Profile]
[Company Profile]
[Company Profile]
[Company Profile][27]

**Shenzhen Woer Electric Technology Co., Ltd., a subsidiary owned by Shenzhen Woer Heat-shrinkable
Material Co., Ltd., is a company specialized in the development and production of power cable
accessories used in a multitude of industry sectors.**

Backed by the parent company's 20 years of experience in the field of heat shrink and cold shrink
tubing, we pride ourselves in our expertise now spanning across a diverse range of industries
including electric power transmission, electric power distribution, switchgear insulation, mining,
petrochemical and telecommunications.

[More Information][28]
[Applications][29]

Woer Electric is a national high-tech company with over 20 years of experience in engineering,
manufacturing and marketing cable accessories.
* 1. [[Power Transmission]][30]
  2. [Power Transmission][31]The company has made a firm commitment to maintaining a leading
     position within the industry and providing safe protection and intelligent connection...
* 1. [[Telecommunication]][32]
  2. [Telecommunication][33]Woer Electric provides effective solutions for communication system
     protection against water and moisture, thus ensuring stable communication services.

[Shenzhen Woer Electric Technology Co., Ltd. (Woer Electric)]
With 20 years of experience, Woer Electric offers custom heat shrink and cold shrink cable
accessories to satisfy your specific needs of power transmission.
